情 · jeong

Jeong is the warmth between people.

English has no clean word for it. Jeong is kindness, generosity and the quiet bond that forms over a shared table. Hearth & Broth is a made-up restaurant for this sample, so this paragraph shows where the owner's own story goes: who they are, why they opened, and what makes the place theirs.

Gukbap is a humble rice soup tied to everyday life in the port city of Busan. Here the pork stock takes many hours, and the cooks make everything around it on site. Order the soondae if you are curious. It tends to win over people who came in unsure.
